messages:
rachel (eng-releases): kicking off regional rollout dry-run: US -> EU (pin) -> APAC. 10% canary, 20m hold. deploy-bot: starting canary slice=canary-10 in us-east-1.
deploy-bot: preflight actions: attach-warm-pool, kv-prefetch, quant-profile=v3.1.
leo (oncall): quick capacity check: spare GPUs in US? sustained headroom for tokens/sec?
alma (eng-infra): US spare: 4 GPUs (~120k TUs/hr). headroom ~30% at baseline. APAC currently low (6%).
mike (sre): APAC racks temp trending 77C, suggest holding APAC until cool-down. set conservative burst for APAC if we must warm.
tina (product): EU legal asked EU remain on v2.3.7 this wave. can we pin?
ara (support): will reflect that in release notes if pinned.
rachel (eng-releases): decision: pin eu-west-1 to v2.3.7. deploy-bot: `pin --region eu-west-1 --version v2.3.7 --reason "legal/schema"`
deploy-bot: pin applied.
leo (oncall): rollback triggers proposals: p95>210ms for 2 consecutive 10m OR 5xx>0.9% for 5m OR OOM/thermal>80C immediate.
mike (sre): agree. rollback action: `deploybot rollback --region <r> --to-version <prev>` + `deploybot route --region <r> --to dedicated-fallback`.
deploy-bot: smoke test in US canary: 50 reqs -> 49/50 OK, p95=145ms, median=78ms. kv-hit=85%.
ara (support): drafting APAC customer note in case we delay warmup.
alma (eng-infra): applying short-circuit fallback for us-east-1: `deployctl set-fallback --region us --target dedicated-fallback --thresholds p95:200ms:10m,5xx:0.8%`
deploy-bot: fallback policy active.
rachel (eng-releases): US holdpoint 20m; if stable, open EU to 10% (pinned). APAC warmup deferred by 40m pending temps. If US regresses, halt other regions and execute rollback.
deploy-bot: canary status: us-east-1 healthy; holdpoint reached.
